text:
Vikram Shah: opened a small PR to add an "embedding sharding" note to the Tilde-8B card and include a JavaScript SDK v3 example for sharded embeds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/934
Eve Park: thanks Vikram. Quick ask: can the embed section explicitly point to the canonical embed-sharding guide instead of a local anchor? Customers keep following stale anchors.
Vikram Shah: good call. I'll point to /docs/embedding-sharding.
Jonah Reed: also check the JS snippet param names. SDK v3 uses `input` (array) and `batch_size` for client.embeddings.create calls. The old snippet used `texts` and `chunk_size`.
Vikram Shah: updated the snippet to the v3 shape and tested locally. New snippet:```js
// shard inputs into pieces for large documents
const parts = splitDocument(docText, 5_000);
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'tilde-8b',
  input: parts,
  batch_size: 16,
});
```
Tara: nit: mention that embedding sharding affects shard alignment with downstream retrieval (i.e., store shard ids). One sentence under "Embedding guidelines" should do it.
Vikram Shah: added a short note about storing shard metadata and how to stitch results back in retrieval.
Mira Patel: bench numbers for embedding throughput are currently labeled "a100, runtime v1.13". Can we add a TODO to re-run on v1.14 (kernel improvements) and create a ticket so customers see it's tracked?
Vikram Shah: created INF-1988 to re-run embed throughput on v1.14 and linked it in the PR. Added a parenthetical to the card: "benchmarks measured on a100, runtime v1.13; re-run scheduled (INF-1988)".
Samira (docs-bot): running linkcheck and render checks on branch vikram/tilde-embed-shard.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck report: 1 broken anchor (old /model-cards#embed-shard). Recommendation: point to /docs/embedding-sharding. Spellcheck OK.
Eve Park: tiny wording nit: change "shard documents into 5k chunks" -> "shard documents into ~5k-token pieces" for clarity.
Vikram Shah: updated wording and pushed.
Jonah Reed: one more compat note: if we list a quant variant (tilde-8b-aurora-quant) add a short line that it may fallback to tilde-8b-fp16 when kernels unavailable and that embedding accuracy may vary slightly after aggressive quant.
Vikram Shah: added compat caveat and recommendation: "Prefer fp16 for embedding-heavy workloads that require exact float fidelity".
Samira (docs-bot): render check passed after recent pushes. Merge window OK (02:00-09:00 UTC).
Tara: approved from a docs perspective.
Mira Patel: approved; thanks for adding the embedding guidance and clear JS snippet.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Vikram Shah at 4551237090. Changelog: "tilde-8b: embed sharding guidance, JS SDK v3 snippet, bench link -> INF-1988"
Vikram Shah: thanks all, closing loop. :white_check_mark:
